evaluation.code:
| base report classes cases d v row a b root nested ref builder result snapshot builders make encode source gate roots error sourceBefore |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
classes := #(MADescription MAContainer MAPriorityContainer MAElementDescription MABooleanDescription MAClassDescription MAStringDescription MAMemoDescription MAPasswordDescription MASymbolDescription MAMagnitudeDescription MANumberDescription MAReferenceDescription MATokenDescription MAOptionDescription MASingleOptionDescription MAMultipleOptionDescription MARelationDescription MAToOneRelationDescription MAToManyRelationDescription MAToManyScalarRelationDescription).
cases := OrderedCollection new.
classes do: [ :cls |
 d := (Smalltalk globals at: cls) basicNew initialize label: cls asString; yourself.
 v := MAPortVisitorProbe new.
 v visit: d.
 cases add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> cls asString. 'events' -> v events asArray }) ].
a := MAStringDescription new label: 'First'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #first); priority: 20; yourself.
b := MANumberDescription new label: 'Second'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #second); priority: 10; yourself.
ref := MAStringDescription new label: 'Reference'; yourself.
d := MASingleOptionDescription new label: 'Option'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #choice); reference: ref; options: #('a' 'b'); yourself.
root := MAContainer new label: 'Root'; add: a; add: b; add: a; add: d; yourself.
v := MAPortVisitorProbe new.
v visit: root.
row := Dictionary newFrom: { 'plainContainer' -> v events asArray }.
v := MAPortVisitorProbe new recurse: true; yourself.
v visit: root.
row at: 'recursiveContainer' put: v events asArray.
v := MAPortVisitorProbe new stopAt: #visitStringDescription:; yourself.
v visitAll: { a. b. a }.
row at: 'stoppedBatch' put: v events asArray.
a beHidden; beReadOnly.
v := MAPortVisitorProbe new.
v visit: a.
row at: 'hiddenReadOnly' put: v events asArray.
a beVisible; beWriteable.
v := MAPortVisitorProbe new failAt: #visitStringDescription:; yourself.
error := [ v visitAll: { a. b }. 'none' ] on: Error do: [ :e | e class name asString ].
row at: 'failedBatch' put: v events asArray; at: 'failureClass' put: error.
encode := [ :node | Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> node class name asString. 'label' -> node label. 'key' -> (node accessor name ifNil: [ '' ]) asString. 'priority' -> node priority. 'children' -> (node isContainer ifTrue: [ node children collect: encode ] ifFalse: [ #() ]) asArray } ].
builders := OrderedCollection new.
make := [ :name :input |
 builder := MAPortBuilderProbe new.
 sourceBefore := encode value: input.
 result := builder buildFrom: input target: (Dictionary newFrom: { #first -> 'Ada'. #second -> 7 }).
 builders add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'case' -> name. 'source' -> sourceBefore. 'sourceAfter' -> (encode value: input). 'result' -> (encode value: result). 'events' -> builder events asArray. 'sameRoot' -> (result == input). 'sameFirstChild' -> (input isContainer and: [ input children notEmpty and: [ result isContainer and: [ result children notEmpty and: [ input children first == result children first ] ] ] ]).
 'defaultPriority' -> builder priority. 'modelIsNil' -> builder model isNil. 'targetFirst' -> (builder target at: #first) }) ].
make value: 'flat' value: root.
make value: 'empty' value: (MAContainer new label: 'Empty'; yourself).
make value: 'priority' value: (MAPriorityContainer new label: 'Priority'; add: a; add: b; yourself).
nested := MAContainer new label: 'Nested'; add: (MAStringDescription new label: 'Inner'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #inner); yourself); yourself.
make value: 'nested' value: (MAContainer new label: 'Outer'; add: b; add: nested; add: (MAStringDescription new label: 'Last'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #last); yourself); yourself).
make value: 'scalar' value: (MAStringDescription new label: 'Scalar'; accessor: (MADictionaryAccessor key: #scalar); yourself).
builder := MADescriptionBuilder new.
result := builder buildFrom: d target: nil.
snapshot := Dictionary newFrom: { 'scalarSame' -> (result == d). 'referenceSame' -> (result reference == ref). 'optionsSame' -> (result options == d options) }.
builder := MADescriptionBuilder new.
result := builder buildFrom: root target: nil.
snapshot at: 'containerSame' put: (result == root); at: 'childrenSame' put: (result children == root children); at: 'duplicateCopySame' put: (result children first == result children third); at: 'referenceCopySame' put: (result children last reference == ref); at: 'optionsCopySame' put: (result children last options == d options).
builder priority: 9; model: a.
snapshot at: 'priorityAfter' put: builder priority; at: 'modelSame' put: (builder model == a).
error := [ builder buildFrom: b target: nil. 'none' ] on: Error do: [ :e | e class name asString ].
snapshot at: 'reuseContainerCount' put: builder builtDescription children size; at: 'reuseError' put: error.
Dictionary newFrom: { 'dispatch' -> cases asArray. 'visiting' -> row. 'builders' -> builders asArray. 'identity' -> snapshot. 'builderClass' -> (Dictionary newFrom: { 'name' -> MADescriptionBuilder name asString. 'superclass' -> MADescriptionBuilder superclass name asString. 'abstract' -> MADescriptionBuilder isAbstract. 'label' -> MADescriptionBuilder label }).
 'policy' -> 'Executed real visitor and builder objects in live GT. Probe subclasses were compiled through GT MCP and are removed after reference capture. Base visitor dispatch does not filter or traverse. Builder behavior includes upstream state reuse and nested-container replacement. No native integration resources.' }
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'visitor-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base , 'visitor-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].
{ (report at: 'dispatch') size. (report at: 'builders') size }
